# HARS Memory - retrieval architecture

## Overview
HARS Memory is a long-term memory service for an agent. It turns a corpus of notes into an entity/relation graph plus chunk embeddings, and answers recall queries with a hybrid of dense search, BM25 and graph traversal. This note is a synthetic demo; it contains no real corpus data.

## Chunking
Notes are split by the md_struct chunker along Markdown headings. Each chunk keeps its [H1 > H2] breadcrumb and line range, so a citation can point back to the exact section of the source document.

## Retrieval channels
Dense search embeds the question with EmbeddingGemma and scans chunk vectors. BM25 searches words. The graph channel expands the entities named in the question by one hop. Ripgrep is a ranked lexical channel for files outside the index.

## Fusion
Channels are fused by rank: the weighted reciprocal-rank fusion combines dense, BM25, graph and ripgrep candidates into one pool, with a small z-score bonus for decisive single-channel wins.

## Ranking
A learned ranker reorders the fused pool using channel scores, ranks, agreement, identifier hits and provenance features. It runs on CPU in under a millisecond per candidate.

## Trace
Every recall emits a trace: the question, the channel hits, the fusion order, the graph walk, the assembled context and the final answer preview. The visualizer replays this trace step by step.

entities.name: HARS Memory
entities.desc: The long-term memory service: a GraphRAG hybrid over a note corpus.

entities.name: md_struct
entities.desc: Chunker that splits a note along Markdown headings, keeping [H1 > H2] breadcrumbs.

entities.name: EmbeddingGemma
entities.desc: Embedding model that maps questions and chunks into one semantic space.

entities.name: BM25
entities.desc: Lexical ranking function over chunk text.

entities.name: Graph channel
entities.desc: One-hop expansion of the entities named in the question.

entities.name: Ripgrep
entities.desc: Ranked lexical channel for files that are not in the index.

entities.name: WRRF
entities.desc: Weighted reciprocal-rank fusion that combines the retrieval channels.

entities.name: Learned ranker
entities.desc: CPU LightGBM ranker over channel and provenance features.

entities.name: Fusion pool
entities.desc: The merged candidate set before ranking and truncation.

entities.name: Recall trace
entities.desc: Per-query record of channels, fusion, graph walk and context.

entities.name: Context blocks
entities.desc: The assembled evidence handed to the caller.

entities.name: Answer preview
entities.desc: Extractive quotes shown as the answer in the demo.

entities.desc: Entities, relations, chunks and their vectors.
